main_text.p: II.Thomas Erastus doctissimus Medicus, part. 2. disp-de Medicina nova Paracelsi, Magiam naturalem nulla vel esse vel fuisse unquam, aliquoties affirmat. Contradicunt Erasto magno consensu Philosophi, imo Theologorum eruditorum plurimi. Elegantia sunt Coelij Rhodigini verba lib. 9. lect. antiq. cap. 23. Qui accuratius, inquit, introspicere ista enixi sunt, magia fa-stigia duo deprehenderunt: Alterum infame est & immundo-rum spirituum commercium inauspicatum: reliquum si pensita-tius explores dispiciasque, non fere aliud est, quam naturalis Philosophiae apex: Prius goetia, posterius Magia proprie dicitur. Inclinant in hanc sententiam Plinius, cum alibi, tum l. 2. Laert. in vita Philos. Alb. M. Fracastorius, Marsilius Ficinus libr. 4. Theologiae Platon. cap. 4. Cardanus in libris de subtilitatibus; Baptista Porta, in Magia naturali. Weckerus in naturae secretis; Lemnius in libris de occultis naturae. Pererius 1. de Magia: lib. cap. 3. Martinus Delrius disquisitionum magicarum libr. 1. c. 3. 4. Pineda libr. 3, de rebus Salomonis cap. 23. Conimbri-censes, quaest. procem. in l. phys. 2. art. 4. Majolus tom. 2. dierum Canicul. Peucerus in libro de Divinatione & prae omnibus aliis Thomas Campanella, in libro de sensu rerum & Magia. Caesar Longinus in trino Magico. Quid, quod Apollonium Tyanaeum famosissimum Magum excusat Iustinus Martyr. q. 20. ad Orthodoxos, ipsiusque opera naturae viribus adscribat? quo de tamen merito dubitamus.

page.notes: The page is printed with a running head "SECT. I. CAP. IV." and page number 69 at the head, catchword "tur." and gathering signature "E 3" at the foot. Doubtful readings: "cap. 23" after "Elegantia sunt Coelij Rhodigini" is printed with a 3-like numeral and is read as 23. The italic spans are judged from the scan and may not be exact. "penitius" was read as "pensita-tius" (hyphenated across the line end). The Greek words are copied as printed; accents should be checked against the scan. The paragraph runs over into the next page at "celebran-". The first paragraph does not continue from the previous page, since it opens with the numbered item "II.".
